labels.name: get_deal
labels.description: Get full details for one published ShopAt deal by numeric id or slug: price, was-price, discount, voucher code, store, keywords, expiry, ShopAt page and tracked outbound link.

labels.name: hot_deals
labels.description: ShopAt's current top-ranked UK deals (heat, clicks and votes with time decay, max two per store), optionally within one category.

labels.name: list_categories
labels.description: List ShopAt deal categories with slugs and live deal counts.

labels.name: list_stores
labels.description: List UK retailers that currently have deals on ShopAt, with slugs, domains and deal counts. Optional name search.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_deals · Private data: submit_deal, link_boundproof_identity · Public sink: submit_deal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_deals · Private data: submit_deal, link_boundproof_identity · Public sink: submit_deal

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
